_doc: What this skill can do for a host pipeline, one entry per capability: a stable id, the file that is the entry point, and one line on what it does. Hosts that orchestrate several skills (for example a production pipeline that calls this one for its explainer stages) read this list to check that every capability is wired or deliberately left out. Add an entry when a new script or template becomes usable on its own; keep ids stable.

capabilities.does: Check and export the episode's fact table; check that the script only cites facts that exist; list sources for the publish notes.
Check the explanation plan (one signature idea, an explanation and a demonstration per concept) against the script.
Find real footage candidates with their licences, download only approved ones, cut labelled clips.
Transcribe one narration take, align it to the script, split it into segments and time every line and word.
Snap cue starts to measured speech onsets.
Cut one window of audio and subtitles out of a longer narrated video.
Render a local HTML scene that exposes window.renderFrame(t) to MP4.
Starting scene for a bright 3D mechanism segment (subjects, links, steps, safe area).
Starting scene for a 2D mechanism segment on the same contract.
Starting scene for a general three.js illustration.
Check a brand pack and render its brand sheet.
Render each segment (reusing unchanged ones by hash), join them under the narration, optionally burn word-by-word captions.
Contact sheet, distinct-scene count, real-asset screen time and motion checks for a rendered clip.
Synthesize deterministic sound effects and record their peaks.
Estimate tempo, beat grid and strong onsets of an audio file.
Generate a music bed with Google Lyria (paid, the user's own key).
